instruction.text: Jasmine has written some short stories for school. Her first story is about an explorer in the jungle. Select all the words where she has used the wrong plural and possessive endings.

hint.text: Remember, plural words should end in an -s and possessive words should end with -'s.
hint.sound: Remember, plural words should end in an s, and possessive words should end with an apostrophe and an s.

atoms.a: The animals of the jungle watched as the explorer looked at the map’s pages. He was completely lost in the trees. His eyes hunted for something helpful while his hands shook. A parrot’s squawk caused him to look up, and then he saw it. Through the trees, the faint outline of a path was just visible. He took some deep breaths and ventured on.
atoms.b: The animals of the jungle watched as the explorer looked at the ((maps)) ((page’s)). He was completely lost in the trees. His ((eye’s)) hunted for something helpful while his hands shook. A ((parrots)) squawk caused him to look up, and then he saw it. Through the ((tree’s)), the faint outline of a path was just visible. He took some deep ((breath’s)) and ventured on.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct plural and possessive endings.

atoms.a: The animals of the jungle watched as the explorer looked at the maps page’s. He was completely lost in the trees.
atoms.b: The animals of the jungle watched as the explorer looked at the map((s ++’s)) page((++s 's)). He was completely lost in the trees.

atoms.a: His eyes hunted for something helpful while his hands shook.
atoms.b: His eye((++s 's)) hunted for something helpful while his hands shook.

atoms.a: A parrots squawk caused him to look up, and then he saw it.
atoms.b: A parrot((s ++’s)) squawk caused him to look up, and then he saw it.

atoms.a: Through the trees, the faint outline of a path was just visible.
atoms.b: Through the tree((++s 's)), the faint outline of a path was just visible.

atoms.a: He took some deep breath’s and ventured on.
atoms.b: He took some deep breath((++s 's)) and ventured on.
